title: Esophagogastrectomy Versus Extended Gastrectomy in AEG II
brief_summary: Comparison of the oncological outcome of patients who underwent esophagogastrectomy versus extended gastrectomy due to carcinomas of the esophagogastric junction (Siewert type II)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Carcinoma of the esophagogastric junction (AEG type II)
* Age of Minimum 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* non
study_population: Patients with carcinomas of the esophagogastric junction
